sourceOfTruth: Defines the ordered responsibility, route ownership, current implementation seams, and explicit exclusions for the five authenticated Host destinations. Runtime behavior remains owned by production code and its specialist data contracts.

features.purpose: Act as the organizer command centre: show the live or next event, surface every authoritative time-sensitive task inside the policy horizon, and route the host to the safest immediate action.
responsibilities: Own the /host/today route, its authentication and organizer-selection states, and its provider-free body composition.
Fetch the bounded active-event context independently of the Events inventory controller.
Consume the manager-authorized attention callable, parse exhaustive coverage, and merge device-local attendance retry or conflict work.
Order work by urgency, consequence, deadline, and stable identity without inferring mandatory tasks from missing optional data.
Own the dedicated Dress Rehearsal entry point and typed handoffs to Events, Event Manage, Audience, Inbox, Applications, and Payouts.
Keep incomplete attention sources visible so the screen cannot claim a false all-clear.
doesNotOwn: The durable event inventory, history pagination, event creation internals, or event-management mutations.
CRM segmentation, form authoring, messaging workflows, organizer settings, payout onboarding behavior, or rehearsal runtime internals.
A generic notification feed or speculative reminders derived from null setup fields, unread messages, aggregate counts, or zero staff grants.
